neighbours.label: a preposition that opens an intervening phrase while the verb's main complement is still to come: 'explains to small farmers IN developing countries how…', 'gave to every fisherman ON the coast the right…' (also German and Spanish); quiet on the same prepositional phrase when nothing is pending. The - pole fires on the determiner that starts the postponed object, the other end of the same construction
fire: The charter granted to all merchants in the northern towns the right to hold a weekly fair.
The guide describes for young doctors in rural clinics how to treat snake bites.
Deshalb wird seit 2005 in mehreren Bundesländern der neue Lehrplan erprobt.
The law guaranteed to every tenant on the estate a share of the harvest.
El ministro prometió llevar a cabo en todas las provincias la reforma del agua.
The nurse showed to the mothers at the clinic how the vaccine is given.
The king offered to all the knights at his court a place in the fleet.
In der Praxis ist (außerhalb der Ferienzeit) mit kurzen Wartezeiten zu rechnen.
quiet: All merchants in the northern towns held a weekly fair.
Young doctors in rural clinics treat snake bites often.
Der neue Lehrplan ist gut und die Lehrer mögen ihn.
Every tenant on the estate got a share of the harvest.
El ministro visitó todas las provincias el año pasado.
The mothers at the clinic watched the nurse.
The knights lived at his court for years.
Die Wartezeiten sind kurz und das Personal ist freundlich.

notes: Probes: German 'wird seit 1973 in vielen Leitlinien die…' 1.27, 'ist (innerhalb Deutschlands) mit…' 0.97, Spanish 'poner en marcha en todo el país el…' 0.82, 'gave to every fisherman on the coast the right' 0.59, 'explains to small farmers in developing countries how' 0.56, 'explained to the pupils at the back why' 0.45, 'sent to her cousins in Norway a box' 0.31; 'The fisherman on the coast sold…' 0.02, 'has cousins in Norway' 0.02, 'sat in the box' 0.02.
